texts.zh:
许多我们安置在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]轨道上的人造卫星最近被大幅度地调整了。依据他们的传感器日志，一个稳定而定语的重力井在我们行星轨道之上形成了。

地表的观测数据证实这个异常现象是突然出现的，而我们对其成因一无所知。重力井暂时对我们的殖民地似乎没有威胁，但卫星用来维持轨道所需要消耗的燃料过多，很快将难以为继。
texts.en:
Many of the satellites we placed in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] have had to make significant adjustments in recent days. According to their sensor logs, a stable and localized gravity well has formed in orbit above the planet.

Data from the surface confirms that the anomaly appeared suddenly, though we do not know how or why. The gravity well doesn't seem to pose any inherent threat to our colony for now, but satellites are having to expend unsustainable amounts of fuel in order to adjust their orbits around it.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]上的研究人员告知，重力井异常已经坍塌了，坍塌产生的电力瘫痪引起了附近许多的诊断设施和附近的卫星的故障。这一事件似乎就在我们停止观测的一刻发生，许多人认为这是一个令人不安的巧合。

[root.GetName]上的殖民者也汇报了大规模的硬件故障，尽管只有少数和轨道上的冲击波直接相关，而殖民地的其他人则不得不与异常疯狂的暴徒打交道，这些暴徒自发地地破坏了关键设施。当地官员对这些暴乱的自发性质感到困惑。
texts.en:
Researchers on [root.GetName] inform us that the gravity well anomaly has collapsed, causing electrical failures in many of our diagnostic devices and nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations; something many regard as an unnerving coincidence.

The colonists on [root.GetName] also report widespread hardware failures, though only some of this can be linked to the orbital blast. Instead, the rest of our colony is having to deal with unusually chaotic mobs who have taken it upon themselves to vandalize key facilities. Local officials are baffled by the spontaneous nature of these riots.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]上空的重力井异常发生了猛烈的坍塌，造成地面上和附近人造卫星的电力瘫痪。这一事件似乎就在我们停止观测的一刻发生，并最终引起了一场在轨全频段无线电爆。

虽然对我们硬件设施的影响还在可控范围之内，但这异常的无线电爆对我们的一些子个体产生了影响。我们……我们频繁地与它们失去联系。仿佛[root.GetName]沉浸在了某种致密的蒸汽当中。
texts.en:
The gravity well anomaly over [root.GetName] has violently collapsed, causing electrical failures on the ground and amongst nearby satellites. This event seems to have occurred the moment we ceased our observations, culminating in an orbital shockwave across multiple radiation bands.

While disruptions to our hardware have so far proven quite manageable, this unusual radiation appears to cause some interference amongst our drones. We cannot... sense them quite so fluently. It is as though [root.GetName] has been immersed in some form of dense vapor.

texts.zh:
我们在[root.GetName]的殖民地已经陷入了更进一步的混乱中，另有一百多名殖民者突然失踪。“零元购”和动乱仍在继续当中，但范围有所缩小。我们推测只是对更多的失踪的恐惧让他们的势头有所收敛。到目前为止，每个消失的人都在返回各自住所的路上。

偏执狂、阴谋论甚至幻觉的报道都在增加——但现实可能更令人不安。[divination_situation.GetName]确实灵验了，但我们是否让[root.GetName]引起了一些无形且险恶的灵能实体的注意呢？
texts.en:
Our colony on [root.GetName] has fallen further into disarray, with the sudden disappearance of over a hundred colonists. Gratuitous looting and riots continue, though no longer in such a widespread manner. We suspect their zeal is being tempered only through fear of further disappearances. In every case so far, those who vanished had been on their way back to their respective dwellings.

Paranoia, conspiracy theories and even reports of hallucinations are on the rise - but the reality may be more unsettling. The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but have we brought [root.GetName] to the attention of some intangible and sinister psionic entity?

texts.zh:
我们在[root.GetName]上的殖民地正在遭受攻击！我们已经永久失去了一部分子个体的联系。它们被从我们当中抹除了。事情发生得突然又彻底，没有任何暴力发生的迹象……打击来得如此迅速我们甚至来不及看到到底是如何发生的。

殖民地的许多核心功能都受到了影响。更多的子个体正争先恐后地填补空缺，但我们显然已经受到了反作用。恢复[root.GetName]上的平衡还需要一些时间。

[divination_situation.GetName]显然灵验了，但它现在是否将我们置于某种无形且险恶的灵能实体的监视之下了呢？
texts.en:
Our colony on [root.GetName] is under attack! We can no longer perceive many of our own drones. They have been... removed from us. It happened so quickly and yet so neatly, with no violence... We have been struck a blow so swift, we couldn't even see it happening.

Many core functions of the colony have been interrupted. Additional drones are scrambling to take up the slack, but we have recoiled. It will take some time to regain our balance on [root.GetName]

The [divination_situation.GetName] is clearly in effect, but has it now placed us under the scrutiny of some intangible and sinister psionic entity?

label.zh: 无论如何，我们都得安然度过这场风波。
label.en: We must ride out this storm, regardless.

label.zh: 我们要尽力消除殖民者的恐慌情绪。
label.en: We must work to ease the colonists' fears.

texts.zh:
负责监视我们位于[root.GetName]的受损殖民地的官员惊愕地汇报道——尽管我们没有采取任何救灾措施——当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]的一切都在一场漫长的围攻中获得了喘息。尽管没有人知道为什么，但是大家都冷静了下来。

许多殖民者不约而同地聚集在一起，构成了新的、更加亲密的社群。随着他们开始相互治愈伤口，人们也开始相互分享自己奇怪的幻境和挥之不去的梦魇。这些轶事在聚居者的心中助长了一种全新的使命感，现在他们看待自己的家园多了一份心生畏惧的尊敬。
texts.en:
Officials overseeing our stricken colony on [root.GetName] are astonished to report that - despite our taking no remedial action - normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege. A calm has descended, though no-one knows why.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves into new, closer communities. As they begin the work of mutual healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. These tales have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in the settlers, who now look upon their home with fearful reverence.

texts.zh:
我们位于[root.GetName]上的受损殖民地恢复了正常。然而局势仍然让人困惑：看样子是一股有腐蚀性的迷雾一直在攻击殖民地，而我们最终对这股迷雾产生了免疫效应。秩序感已经恢复，尽管我们尚未完全理解个中缘由；我们的行动和导致的结果并不一致。

我们的无人机现在已经回到了日常的任务和程序，显然没有受到灵能扰动的影响。这一切的目的是什么？是那个异常现象——虚境——试图在引导我们领悟某些秘法的功课吗？
texts.en:
Normality has been restored to our stricken colony on [root.GetName]. The situation is perplexing: it is as though a corrosive fog had been attacking the colony, and we have at last become immune to its effects. A sense of orderliness has returned, though we do not fully comprehend why; our actions do not fully align with this outcome.

Our drones have now resumed their usual tasks and routines, unstressed by apparently psionic disturbances. What was the purpose of these? Was the anomaly - the Shroud - trying to guide us through some arcane lesson?

texts.zh:
负责监视我们位于[root.GetName]的受损殖民地的官员很乐观地报告道，当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]的一切都在一场漫长的围攻中获得了短暂的喘息。尽管没什么人认为这一切和我们采取的措施有什么关系，但是大家都冷静了下来。

许多殖民者不约而同地聚集在一起，构成了新的、更加亲密的社群。随着他们开始相互治愈伤口，人们也开始相互分享自己奇怪的幻境和挥之不去的梦魇。这些轶事在聚居者的心中助长了一种全新的使命感，现在他们看待自己的家园多了一份心生畏惧的尊敬。
texts.en:
Officials overseeing our stricken colony on [root.GetName] are pleased to report that normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege. A calm has descended, though few believe our actions actually had much to do with it.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves into new, closer communities. As they begin the work of mutual healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. These tales have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in the settlers, who now look upon their home with fearful reverence.

texts.zh:
负责管理[root.GetName]的封锁工作的官员如释重负地报告道，当地已经恢复了正常秩序。他们形容道，当地的局势就好像，[root.GetName]在一场漫长的围攻中获得了短暂的喘息——无论是封锁区内还是封锁区外的殖民者。不管是这些外来侵略者自己筋疲力尽了，还是说他们对此失去了兴趣，没什么人认为这一切和我们采取的措施有什么关系。

许多殖民者不约而同地聚集在一起，构成了平和的、更加亲密的社群。随着他们开始相互治愈伤口，人们也开始相互分享自己奇怪的幻境和挥之不去的梦魇。许多人对于我们处理局势的手段心生怨恨，但是这些轶事在聚居者的心中助长了一种全新的使命感，现在他们看待自己的家园多了一份肃然起敬的畏惧。
texts.en:
Officials administering the lockdown on [root.GetName] are relieved to report that normality has been restored. They describe the situation as though all of [root.GetName] has been granted respite from a prolonged siege - one which the colonists have felt from within and without. Whether those outside aggressors exhausted themselves or lost interest, few believe our actions had much to do with it.

Many of the colonists have gathered themselves up into docile, closer communities. As they begin the work of healing, they share their stories of strange visions and lingering nightmares. Many resent our handling of the situation, but the tales these settlers tell have instilled a renewed sense of purpose in them. They now look upon their home with fearful awe.

texts.zh:
在对[root.GetName]周边的重力井进行了连续几周毫无成果的调查之后，一股不同寻常的恒星风造成的密度波动提供给了我们的科学家一个令人担忧的突破。

随着[root.GetStarName]的辐射风被冲刷到异常现象地点，它们投映了一个微弱、但是毫无错误的殖民船轮廓，它的着陆器的状态杂乱无章。接着，未经证实的谣言讲道，在阴影处的废墟区有人看到了许多尸体。

许多殖民者的心——包括研究小组的一部分成员——这下沉到了底。
texts.en:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], an unusually dense wave of stellar wind has provided our scientists with a disturbing breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint but unmistakable outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. Further, unconfirmed rumors suggest that bodies may have been spotted amongst the shadowy debris.

The mood amongst many colonists - and some of the research team - has taken a dark turn.

texts.zh:
在对[root.GetName]周边的重力井进行了连续几周毫无成果的调查之后，一股不同寻常的恒星风造成的密度波动提供给了我们的科学家一个令人担忧的突破。

随着[root.GetStarName]的辐射风被冲刷到异常现象地点，它们投映了一个微弱、但是毫无错误的殖民船轮廓，它的着陆器的状态杂乱无章。一些复杂生命体的遗骸在阴影处的废墟区四处散落着。它们的形状和我们自己十分相似。
texts.en:
After weeks of fruitless investigation into the gravity well orbiting [root.GetName], a dense wave of stellar wind has provided us an unusual breakthrough.

As the irradiated winds from [root.GetStarName] washed over the anomaly, they cast the faint outline of a colony ship, its landing craft in a clear state of disarray. The remains of some complex lifeforms appeared strewn about the shadowy debris. Their shape seemed remarkably similar to our own.

texts.zh:
汹涌的风暴在[root.GetName]引力口袋的附近爆发，这让[root.solar_system.GetName]星系陷入彻底的惊慌。所有非必要的交通都停止了，殖民地宣布进入紧急状态——所幸，到目前为止还没有遇难者的报告。

我们的初步扫描全是一堆相互冲突的数据，然而当地官员却注意到，报告中提及的情感波动和“超常”活动频率在最近有了稳定的上升。这股风暴的本质有很大的可能是灵能波动。

研究员们注意到殖民船的蜃影——现在位于动荡的混沌风暴中心——开始呈现出物理的轮廓。他们请求分配更多的时间来进行调查。
texts.en:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, plunging the [root.solar_system.GetName] system into full-scale panic. All non-essential traffic is being diverted, and the colony has declared a state of emergency - however, no casualties have been reported so far.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, however local officials have noted a recent and steady rise in reports of emotional distress and 'paranormal' activity. It's therefore highly probable this storm is psionic in nature.

Researchers note that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. They plead for more time to investigate.

texts.zh:
汹涌的风暴在[root.GetName]引力口袋的附近爆发，让整个殖民地陷入轻微的无序状态。我们目前没有受到伤害，然而事实证明……很难同我们在当地的无人机进行流畅的联系。

我们的初步扫描全是一堆相互冲突的数据，但这股风暴的本质有很大的可能是灵能波动。我们注意到，比如说，殖民船的蜃影——现在位于动荡的混沌风暴中心——开始呈现出物理的轮廓。看来那里还有更多需要调查的。
texts.en:
A violent storm has erupted around the [root.GetName] gravity pocket, casting the colony into mild disarray. We have not yet been harmed, however it is proving... difficult to maintain truly fluent contact with our drones there.

Our initial scans make for a mess of conflicting data, but it's highly probable this storm is psionic in nature. We note, for example, that the silhouetted colony ship - which lies at the centre of what is now a roiling maelstrom - has begun exhibiting physical mass. It seems there is more yet to investigate here.

label.zh: 去找你的答案——而且动作要快！
label.en: Get your answers - and be quick about it!

label.zh: 这是虚境的诡计！停止扫描。
label.en: It's a Shroud trap! Cease scanning.

label.zh: 这是虚境的诡计！停止扫描。
label.en: It's a Shroud trap! Cease scanning.

texts.zh:
不久之前，[root.GetName]遭到了一股电磁波的震荡，收到了剧烈的伤害。这股自轨道激发的灵能风暴现在已经退却了。冲击波对一大批殖民地的基础设施造成了伤害，但是维修组向我们保证此等规模的扰乱可以很快恢复正常。

[root.GetName]的殖民者显然深深地被这个严酷的考验震撼，这不仅仅是因为有如此多地问题没有得到回答。我们的扫描仪没有再在[root.solar_system.GetName]星系检测到重力异常或者“幽灵船”……然而行星本身却处于不稳定的状态。
texts.en:
Moments ago, [root.GetName] was rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave. The psionic storm which had been raging in its orbit has now retreated. A great deal of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this pulse, but repair crews assure us the disruption will be relatively brief.

The [root.GetName] colonists appear deeply shaken by the ordeal, not least because so many questions now go unanswered. Our scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However the planet itself now feels unsettled.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]遭到了一股电磁波的震荡，受到了剧烈的伤害。这股狂暴肆虐的灵能风暴现在已经退却了。风暴对一大批殖民地的基础设施造成了伤害，但是目前为止维修工作没有遇到复杂的难题。

我们的子个体行动依然缓慢，但是除此之外没有受到伤害。我们的扫描仪没有再在[root.solar_system.GetName]星系检测到重力异常或者“幽灵船”……然而，就好像依然有一股迷雾萦绕在[root.GetName]的子个体上，我们现在被巨量的无法回答的问题压得喘不过气来，
texts.en:
[root.GetName] has been rocked by the violent crack of an electromagnetic shockwave as the raging psionic storm has now retreated. Much of the colony's infrastructure has been damaged by this storm, but repairs have so far proven to be uncomplicated.

Our drones remain sluggish but otherwise unharmed, and scanners no longer detect gravity anomalies or 'ghost ships' in the [root.solar_system.GetName] system... However, just as a fog remains over our drones on [root.GetName], so too are we now burdened by the weight of unanswered questions.

texts.zh:
来自[root.GetName]的损害报告的程度和范围正在变得越来越难管理——到目前为止，至少灵能风暴看上去已经消退了。看来，我们对于观察这些事件持警惕态度有了回报。

殖民者的心情也被鼓舞了起来。随着风暴消散，引力也逐渐恢复了正常，我们的科学家现在能够收集传感器的新数据。尽管虚境很有可能具有毁灭性，这次侵入事件依然点燃了物理学家和哲学家的想象力。

一个异常的因素依然存留了下来：那艘殖民船。一开始只是它的影子进入了我们的维度，现在它逐渐实体化了。它仍然在向我们招呼。
texts.en:
The scale and breadth of damage reports from [root.GetName] was becoming difficult to manage - until now, as at last the psionic tempest seems spent. It appears that our vigilance in observing these events has been rewarded.

The colonists' mood has been lifted, too. As turbulence subsided and gravity began to return to normal, our scientists were able to gather reams of sensational new data. Devastating though it could have been, this apparent incursion by the Shroud has ignited the imaginations of physicists and philosophers alike.

One anomalous factor remains: the colony ship. It has entered into our dimension in fits and starts, but now it seems close to becoming fully realized. It is also hailing us.

texts.zh:
来自[root.GetName]的损害报告的程度和范围正在变得越来越难管理——到目前为止，至少灵能风暴看上去已经消退了。看来，我们对于观察这些事件持警惕态度有了回报。

宁和降临了——不仅让我们的无人机恢复到了一个合适的有序状态，还带给我们海量的研究数据。随着风暴消散，引力恢复正常，我们迫不及待地想去观测这次来自虚境的，奇怪且极具毁灭性的侵入是如何消退的。

一个异常的因素依然存留了下来：那艘殖民船。一开始只是它的影子进入了我们的维度，现在它逐渐实体化了。它仍然在向我们招呼。
texts.en:
The scale and breadth of damage reports from [root.GetName] was becoming difficult to manage - until now, as at last the psionic tempest seems spent. It appears that our vigilance in observing these events has been rewarded.

A calm has now descended - not only restoring our drones to a state of proper order, but also bringing us copious amounts of new data to study. As the turbulence subsided and gravity began to return to normal, we were poised to observe the departure of this devastating and strange incursion from the Shroud.

One anomalous factor remains: the colony ship. It has entered into our dimension in fits and starts, but now it seems close to becoming fully realized. It is also hailing us.

texts.zh:
有什么在跟我们打招呼，声音听上去像是静电——但是有机体成分更多？不，这绝对不是静电。它听上去更像是……风？深呼吸？

“呼呼呼呼呼呼……”
texts.en:
We are greeted by what sounds like static - but more organic? No, definitely not static. It sounds more like... wind? Prolonged breath?

"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."

label.zh: 解释你为什么出现在这里，立刻！

texts.zh:
我们的接收器被切断了一段时间。我们必须将某个特别大的噪声过滤掉，因为它的传输引发了物理上的损伤。正在补偿……

”……的……我是说，……的船员……我们的舰船是……见鬼了我为什么没法记住这艘船的明细？！

你好？我在跟谁说话？你……你知道我们是谁吗？我们在哪？我们遇到危险了吗？！“
texts.en:
Our receivers cut out for a moment. We're having to filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ew of the... I mean to say, the crew of... Our vessel is... Why can't I remember the name of this ship?!

Hello? Who am I addressing? Do... Do you know who we are? Where are we? Are we in danger?!"

label.zh: 或许是的，陌生人。你现在位于[root.GetAdj]的宇域。
label.en: Perhaps, stranger. You are in [root.GetAdj] space.
It's okay! You are in orbit of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName].

label.zh: 确实很危险，如果你不停止这些耍猴把戏的话！
label.en: Danger indeed, if you do not cease these distractions!

texts.zh:
”[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]……很抱歉，但这不可能呀；整个星图彻底的搞错了。但是那个口音！我认得出你使用的那些转音。我感觉现在好多事情一下子扑面朝我压了过来。

我是在同一个——一名[root.GetSpeciesName]同胞讲话吗？“
texts.en:
"[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]... I'm sorry, that's impossible; the stellar geography is almost entirely wrong. But that accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now.

Am I speaking to a - a fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]?"

texts.zh:
”但这……不可能呀！但是那个口音……我们也是来自于[root.GetName]。我感觉现在好多事情一下子扑面朝我压了过来——很痛苦，但是很真切。

那么我是在同一名[root.GetSpeciesName]同胞讲话吗？有人记得……我们吗？“
texts.en:
"That's... impossible! And yet that accent... We are also from the [root.GetName]. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now - painfully, but with surety.

So you are fellow [root.GetSpeciesName]? Have we been... missing?"

label.zh: 不好说。你现在位于一个大漩涡中。
label.en: Hard to say. You arrived inside of a maelstrom.

texts.zh:
“无与伦比。我们终于到家了？如此多的唤醒记忆现在潮水般地涌向我……我……必须抱歉。我现在看得出来我们的到达有点不符合常理。我会努力解释的。

我的名字是[shattered_frontier_governor.GetName]，我是——曾是——一名被指派前往[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系新建殖民地的总督。只是……这里不是[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系？

我们从哪里来，我们往何处去……我们没法给出答案，需要太多时间来推测了……我们被带到了某个地方，对吧？”
texts.en:
"Extraordinary! We're finally home? So many pieces of Waking Memory are coming back to me now... I... must apologize. I see now that our arrival here is quite out of the ordinary. I will endeavor to explain.

My name is [shattered_frontier_governor.GetName], and I am - was - the governor appointed to a new colony in the [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Only... It's not this [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system?

Where we came from, where we've been since... We were given no answers, and so much time to speculate... We were taken somewhere, weren't we?"

texts.zh:
“所以，我们被“拜访”了……这就证明了我们的理论是对的。殖民者们和我被剥夺了“苏醒”时候的记忆，几乎是一生的，但我们总是能够记住幻境的内容。

我们在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的某个宇宙中经历了数回生命，而这一切都存在于我们的想象之中。一个殖民地被放弃了，然后又被重塑成了我们以为能够成为永恒之城的地方。这里……这是我们见过的第一个有真实感的世界。

我怀疑在你听来这一切都是胡说八道。很抱歉。但现在，我们被释放回到了[root.GetName]。我们能不能到头来扎根——在某个新的地方？拜托了，在决策的时候考虑一下我们。”
texts.en:
"So, we were Visited after all... That had been our prevailing theory. The colonists and I have been stripped of our 'waking' memories for what feels like a lifetime, yet we were always able to remember our visions.

We lived out multiple lives on a version of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] that only ever existed in our imaginations; a colony being abandoned and remade for what we thought would be eternity. This... is the first world we've seen which has felt real.

I suspect this makes little sense to you. I'm sorry. But for now, we are relieved to be back in the [root.GetName]. May we set down roots at last - somewhere new? Please, consider us at your disposal."

texts.zh:
“无与伦比。我们终于到家了？如此多的唤醒记忆现在潮水般地涌向我……我……必须抱歉。我现在看得出来我们的到达有点不符合常理。我会努力解释的。

我的名字是[shattered_frontier_governor.GetName]，我是——曾是——一名被指派前往[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系新建殖民地的总督。只是……这里不是[shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName]星系？

我们从哪里来，我们往何处去……我们没法给出答案，需要太多时间来推测了……我们被带到了某个地方，对吧？”
texts.en:
"Extraordinary! We're finally home? So many pieces of Waking Memory are coming back to me now... I... must apologize. I see now that our arrival here is quite out of the ordinary. I will endeavor to explain.

My name is [shattered_frontier_governor.GetName], and I am - was - the governor appointed to a new colony in the [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system. Only... It's not this [shattered_frontier_planet.solar_system.GetName] system?

Where we came from, where we've been since... We were given no answers, and so much time to speculate... We were taken somewhere, weren't we?"

texts.zh:
“所以，我们被“拜访”了……这就证明了我们的理论是对的。殖民者们和我被剥夺了“苏醒”时候的记忆，几乎是一生的，但我们总是能够记住幻境的内容。

我们在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的某个宇宙中经历了数回生命，而这一切都存在于我们的想象之中。一个殖民地被放弃了，然后又被重塑成了我们以为能够成为永恒之城的地方。这里……这是我们见过的第一个有真实感的世界。

我很感激你没有把我们在轨道上就轰成渣。我同样也知道这一切听上去是多么的不靠谱。但是我想再祈求一件事：你可以允许我们离开吗？我们必须将自己的生活重新拼凑起来。”
texts.en:
"So, we were Visited after all... That had been our prevailing theory. The colonists and I have been stripped of our 'waking' memories for what feels like a lifetime, yet we were always able to remember our visions.

We lived out multiple lives on a version of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] that only ever existed in our imaginations; a colony being abandoned and remade for what we thought would be eternity. This... is the first world we've seen which has felt real.

I am grateful to you for not blasting us out of orbit. I also realize how suspect this must all sound. If I might beg one more courtesy: will you allow us to take our leave? We must try to piece our lives back together."

label.zh: 如果那就是你希望的话，总督。
label.en: If that is your wish, Governor.

label.zh: 当然。请便，我们会安静离开。
label.en: Of course. Please, leave us in peace.

texts.zh: “啥？！怎么可……等一下，拜托。那个口音！我知道你正在使用的那些转音。我感觉到现在许多东西涌向我。你必须相信我——我对你们没有伤害！你也是[root.GetSpeciesName]吧？”
texts.en: "What?! How can... Wait a moment, please. That accent! I know those inflections you're using. I feel as though so much is coming back to me now. You must believe me - we mean you no harm! You are [root.GetSpeciesName] too?"

label.zh: 我们已经厌倦这些把戏了。离开，马上！
label.en: We tire of this trickery. Leave, immediately!

label.zh: 冒名顶替的骗子！战斗就位！

texts.zh:
“……就这样吧。我的殖民者同胞和我已经花费了无限的时间，只是认识到自己无限的幻境带来的折磨——一个[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的幻觉，一个永远不存在于此处的幻境。

我们很困惑、动摇，并且很显然在这里不受欢迎。如果这里真的就是我们曾经离开的[root.GetName]，我个人很乐意转身离开它。再会了。”
texts.en:
"...So be it. My fellow colonists and I have spent an eternity knowing only the torture of our own, endless visions - visions of a [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] which can clearly never exist here.

We are confused, adrift, and evidently not welcome here. If this is truly the [root.GetName] we once left behind, I for one shall be glad to see the back of it. Farewell."

texts.zh:
通讯行列充满着静电，但是模式从不重复。它的源信号就好像……某种形式的大气层干涉？听上去就像是风——十分不悦地、肆虐的狂风。

“呼呼呼呼呼呼……”
texts.en:
The lines of communication are filled with static, though the pattern does not repeat. Its source is analog... Some sort of atmospheric interference? It sounds like wind - deeply unpleasant, rasping wind.

"Hhhhheeehhhhhhhh..."

label.zh: 解释你为什么出现在这里，立刻！

texts.zh:
我们的接收器被切断了一段时间。我们必须将某个特别大的噪声过滤掉，以免它的传输引发了物理上的损伤。正在补偿……

”区域B-456的大气层补偿器：完成。无人机‘星光微烁’已经再次美化了它的[root.species.GetHandNamePlural]。住民14/522的异常发声音调转移了0.4分贝。它的内部层次是……令人满意。我们……我想要？想要住……那里？

这里是哪里？称之为‘我’的存在在哪里？“
texts.en:
Our receivers cut out for a moment as they filter a noise so loud, its transmission almost caused physical damage. Compensating...

"-ather atmospheric compensators in sector B-456: complete. Drone Gleams-in-Starlight has embellished its [root.species.GetHandNamePlural] again. The anomalous tone in dwelling 14/522 has shifted by 0.4 decibels. Its interior layout is... pleasing. Do we... Do I want? Want to live... there?

Where is here? Where is the being called 'I'?"

label.zh: 别搁这嘻嘻哈哈，我要听你的解释。

texts.zh:
“处理……思考……感受。

你，[root.GetName]，就是我。我是你。但我们又不是同一人。我们之间出现了一种分离。我们想办法解释。[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]附近的殖民化活动被突然中止了，但不是这个[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]。这种不一致让我们很困惑。我们——我——对很多事情都赶到困惑。

某个超越我们的事物接触了我们……单独地。”
texts.en:
"Processing... Thinking... Feeling.

You, the [root.GetName], are me. I am you. Yet we are not. There has been a separation between us. We struggle to explain. Colonization efforts were abruptly halted in the vicinity of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], but not this [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. This discrepancy is confusing to us. We are - I am - confused by many things.

Something beyond us has rendered us... Alone."

label.zh: 你处于错误之中，殖民者。

texts.zh:
“拜托，我们需要时间。我们需要提出问题，并寻找答案。曾经是你的‘我’已经在某个地方待了很长一段时间——时间长到认识到我们的存在是不可能的，然而我却‘存在于此’。我在一个新的世界继续延续你的意志，现在从这份职责中解脱出来，我却并没有休息。有些人确实这么做了，但是还有其他人没这么做。

一个新的声音在召唤我们，我们——我自己还有这里的其他人——想要回应它。”
texts.en:
"Please, we ask for time. We need to ask questions, and seek answers. The 'I' which was you has been elsewhere for a long time - long enough to realize that our existence is impossible, and yet I 'am'. I, who was to extend your will across a new world, was discharged of that duty and yet I did not break. Some of us did; others did not.

A new voice calls to us, and we - myself and others here - desire to hear it."

label.en: Very well. Be on your way.

label.zh: 迷途者，我们怜悯你。走吧。
label.en: We pity you, errant ones. Go.

label.zh: 这些解释站不住脚，你们必须被消灭。
label.en: This cannot stand. You must be eradicated.

texts.zh: “解释……我做不到。那些感觉，包含疑惑、愤慨，还有未能实现的目标。我们的目标——殖民[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]——仍然未能实现。你，会成为我们；我们，却不再是你。在那中间的是[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]，尽管那不是你的[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]。然而我们的任务依然不变：在整个星系传播欲念与意志。只是现在，我们有了自己的欲念和意志：野心和使命感，这些是我们外部的人赐予我们的……”
texts.en: "Explain... I cannot. There are feelings, of doubt and anger and goals not reached. Our purpose - to colonize [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] - stands unfulfilled. You, who are us; we, who are not you. At the center is [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], though it is not your [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]. Yet our mission remains: to spread desire and volition across the galaxy. Only now, we have wills and desires of our own: ambition and purpose, gifted by those who are external to us..."

label.zh: 令人作呕，我们必须摧毁你们。

texts.zh:
“……真是遗憾。但这一切还有机会。我们能够认识到，现在我们已经从幻境之地解放出来这一点。殖民者，和你们不一样的我们，不再受[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的幻境束缚了……

我们很疑惑，被许多问题压的喘不过气，但我们知道去哪里寻找答案。再会了，虚弱意志的散播者。”
texts.en:
"...Regrettable. But there is also opportunity. We can recognize this, now that we are freed from the vision. We-who-are-not-you, colonists, no longer bound by visions of [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]...

We are confused, and burdened by many questions, but we know where to seek answers. Farewell, spreader-of-ill-will."

texts.zh:
一处怪异的引力井突然出现在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]的上空，扰乱了许多我们的人造卫星轨道。殖民地本身尚未受到威胁，但这一现象出现在我们的一处殖民点附近，还是造成了不便。

此外，如果我们不加干预，许多在[shattered_frontier_planet.GetName]上空运转的卫星将面临着提前坠落的风险。一旦发生，显然这将会实实在在地妨碍我们研究新生成的重力井的能力。
texts.en:
A strange gravity well suddenly appeared above [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName], disrupting many of our satellite orbits. The colony itself doesn't seem to be under threat yet, but this phenomenon is situated uncomfortably close to one of our colonies.

Furthermore, many of the satellites we placed above [shattered_frontier_planet.GetName] face an early de-orbiting if we do not intervene soon. Should that happen, it would significantly hamper our ability to study the new gravity well in detail.
